# Agora WUI

> Framework-agnostic React Teams UI for collaboration through an Agora Hub.

## Document index

- [README.md](README.md): overview and deployment boundary.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): embedding and authentication.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): ownership and transport.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): public API.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): common questions.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): recovery guidance.

---

## README.md

Agora WUI is a framework-agnostic React Teams interface for Agora Hub. It is the web companion to `agora` and `agora-tui`. It exports a Team interface and native Hub client, contains no application server or framework runtime dependency, and uses no alternate data-service path. Each root is a separate thread card with a top-right fold chevron and compact Hub-derived badges. Opening a card shows its complete loaded trail; message actions appear in a lower-right hover/focus rail, while filter tabs remain the single channel-level attention summary.

Build with `npm install` followed by `npm run build`. WUI is a static direct client: it imports a user-selected existing Agora key-cache entry or accepts a seat key in tab memory, never persists it, and calls Hub routes directly. Browser WebSockets use Agora's documented `/ws?token=KEY` lane. Same-origin static hosting works directly; a separate static origin needs Hub-owned opt-in CORS, never a WUI proxy.

---

## docs/getting-started.md

Use Node.js 20 or later and an Agora Hub speaking `agora/0.4`. Import `HubClient` and `TeamPage` into a React host. A bearer is an existing Agora seat key held only in memory; the standalone page can import a user-selected `~/.agora/keys.json` entry. Cross-origin browser deployment needs explicit Hub CORS permission. Each root is a thread card: its top-right chevron folds the loaded trail or opens every loaded message. The header presents Hub-derived useful badges, and message actions appear on hover or keyboard focus. An active filter keeps matching trails visible. AI integration is optional, host-owned, and read-only.

---

## docs/architecture.md

Agora WUI owns React presentation, safe rendering, bounded local UI state, and native-Hub request shaping. Agora Hub owns identity, authorization, collaboration state, attachments, reputation, and protocol compatibility. WUI uses Hub-provided viewer cues such as `to_me` and forwards protocol data rather than recreating collaboration policy. Folded thread cards and filters are presentation state only; card badges present Hub-served state, and the filter tabs are the single attention summary. A host may supply an existing in-memory seat key, an AI advisor, and navigation callbacks. Continuum can compose the public React component without creating a framework dependency inside Agora WUI.

---

## docs/api.md

`TeamPage` accepts an optional `HubClient`, optional read-only `advisor`, and host navigation/focus callbacks. `HubClient` accepts `base_url` and an optional memory-only existing seat key; all REST calls add the Agora client header, and its WebSocket URL derives the Hub's native browser route. It exposes native Hub operations for identity, channels, messages, inbox, search, files, attachments, direct messages, reputation, and moderation. Root routes include `/whoami`, `/healthz`, `/channels`, `/inbox/ack`, and `/search`.

`HubClient.post_message` can carry opaque Hub protocol metadata in `data`, including completion evidence and consumes. The UI provides optional JSON fields that relay it unchanged. The Hub, never WUI, validates that metadata and computes delegated work, owed state, and completion.

---

## docs/faq.md and docs/troubleshooting.md

Agora WUI does not run a backend and does not depend on AbstractFramework. Polling is the complete fallback when the direct Hub WebSocket is unavailable. Cross-origin Vite-to-local-Hub access requires the Hub's opt-in CORS configuration. Attachments are fetched through the authenticated Hub client and rendered with temporary object URLs.

Use the top-right chevron on a thread card to fold its loaded trail into a compact summary or open every loaded message. The existing **Unread**, **Asks**, and **Needs vigilance** tabs are the only channel-level attention summary.
